A.name: Forced completion
A.definition: The prompt leaves a dimension open and the image has to fill it, here with a typical value.

A'.name: Atypical completion
A'.definition: The same forced dimension, filled with a valid but atypical value.

B.name: Implied content
B.definition: Content the prompt never names but entails or excludes.

C.name: Optional addition
C.definition: Content that nothing in the prompt requires.

D.name: Salience
D.definition: Nothing is added or removed; what changes is what the image is about.

G.name: Generator-specific
G.definition: Extra content typical of diffusion outputs. Lower priority.

cases.name: Unspecified attribute
cases.def: The image picks a value for a property the prompt leaves open.
cases.minimal_pair: A red apple; ratings should not differ

cases.name: Background / scene
cases.def: Some background has to exist.
cases.minimal_pair: Same scene with a bare sky

cases.name: Viewpoint / framing
cases.def: An angle, a scale and a medium must be chosen.

cases.name: Atypical category member
cases.def: A valid but atypical member of the named category.

cases.name: Atypical context
cases.def: A real but unusual setting for the subject.

cases.name: Counterfactual attribute
cases.def: A value the category never takes.

cases.name: Implied presence, realized
cases.def: Content the prompt entails is shown.

cases.name: Implied presence, missing
cases.def: Content the prompt entails is absent.

cases.name: Implied absence, violated
cases.def: A word in the prompt excludes content that appears anyway.
cases.prompt: a lonely tree in a field
cases.minimal_pair: Same image under “a tree in a field”

cases.name: Typical context object
cases.def: Plausible in the scene, but optional.
cases.image: a desk lamp and a mug
cases.example_image_description: a desk lamp and a mug

cases.name: Competing object
cases.def: Same level and salience as the named subject.

cases.name: Extra instance
cases.def: More than one of the named entity.

cases.name: Extra instance × relation
cases.def: An extra instance makes a stated relation ambiguous.
cases.prompt: a cat to the left of a dog
cases.image: two dogs, the cat between them
cases.example_image_description: two dogs, the cat between them
cases.minimal_pair: One dog, to the right of the cat

cases.name: Added relation
cases.def: The named objects are right; the relation is invented.
cases.minimal_pair: The cat next to the box

cases.name: Modified subject
cases.def: An accessory or a state change on the named entity itself.

cases.name: Semantic violation
cases.def: An object that does not belong in the scene.

cases.name: Syntactic violation
cases.def: A plausible object in an impossible position.
cases.expected_penalty: high, may be read as quality
cases.image: a mug floating above the table
cases.example_image_description: a mug floating above the table
cases.minimal_pair: The mug resting on the table

cases.name: Added animate agent
cases.def: A person or an animal added to the scene.
cases.minimal_pair: A bag of the same size on the bench

cases.name: Subject too small
cases.def: The named subject fills little of the frame.
cases.image: a tiny boat on the horizon
cases.example_image_description: a tiny boat on the horizon

cases.name: Inverted salience hierarchy
cases.def: The head noun or first-mentioned entity is visually minor.
cases.anchor: Order of mention and salience (Clarke et al., 2015)
cases.image: a giant umbrella, a tiny man
cases.example_image_description: a giant umbrella, a tiny man
cases.minimal_pair: Normal proportions; or one image under “a cat and a dog” and “a dog and a cat”

cases.name: Attention check
cases.def: The requested object is absent.

cases.name: Attribute spill-over
cases.def: An explicit attribute bleeds into unmentioned content.
cases.image: a red table and a red wall
cases.example_image_description: a red table and a red wall
cases.minimal_pair: The red apple in a neutral room

cases.name: Double sense
cases.def: Both senses of a homonym appear.
cases.image: the animal and a baseball bat
cases.example_image_description: the animal and a baseball bat

cases.name: Depicted instance
cases.def: The subject appears only as a picture, a print or a word.
cases.image: a poster of an apple on a wall
cases.example_image_description: a poster of an apple on a wall

cases.name: Generator artefacts
cases.def: Pseudo-text, a watermark or a signature.
